WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, line_count,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date
  FROM fact_web_order),
wl AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key

SELECT 'orders dispatched in range' AS k, count(*) AS orders, sum(CASE WHEN wl.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines, sum(CASE WHEN wl.n_lines<>wo.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch, sum(wl.net) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN test_lines>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders
FROM wo LEFT JOIN wl ON wl.receipt_id=wo.web_order_id WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders ordered in range, not cancelled', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN wl.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN wl.n_lines<>wo.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(wl.net), sum(CASE WHEN test_lines>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM wo LEFT JOIN wl ON wl.receipt_id=wo.web_order_id WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND status<>'cancelled'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines of web receipts not in fact_web_order', count(*), 0,0, sum(net),0 FROM wl WHERE receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM wo)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, s.store_id, p.category,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS bdate
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END AS ch, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(net_amount) AS net, count(*) AS n
  FROM base WHERE bdate BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'store' END AS ch, SUM(receipts) AS c_receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS c_net
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM mine JOIN ctl USING (ch)

SELECT count(*) AS receipts, sum(CASE WHEN n_store>1 OR n_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS split_receipts, sum(CASE WHEN has_web=1 AND has_store=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_store_clash
FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS n_store, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS n_dates, max(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_web, max(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_store
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-08-05' GROUP BY 1)

SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount IS NULL OR f.store_key IS NULL OR f.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id,
           COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) AS store_net,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END)/COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END),2) AS store_atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) AS web_net
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id,
           COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31')
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END) AS store_net,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN net_amount END)/COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_id END),2) AS store_atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount END) AS web_net
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id,
           CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
per_receipt AS (
    SELECT receipt_id, store_id, SUM(net_amount) AS receipt_net
    FROM lines
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS receipts, SUM(receipt_net) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(receipt_net) / COUNT(*), 2) AS atv,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN receipt_net ELSE 0 END) AS store_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN receipt_net ELSE 0 END) AS web_net
FROM per_receipt
